name: agent
description: Vibe Codex agent surface built into VibeCode and installable as a VS Code VSIX.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Read-only planning, context inspection, and UI rendering are available in untrusted workspaces. Mutating actions, terminal execution, and worktree preparation remain approval/trust gated.

vibeCodex.extension.preferNativeHost.markdownDescription: Use the native VibeCode workbench agent when it is available, and use the extension fallback surface otherwise.

vibeCodex.extension.codexCommand.markdownDescription: Codex CLI command used by external VS Code installs. VibeCode builds use the native managed app-server bridge.

vibeCodex.extension.codexArgs.markdownDescription: Additional Codex CLI arguments used only by external VS Code installs before the task prompt is appended.

vibeCodex.extension.appServerArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the configured Codex CLI when the external extension starts the JSON-RPC app-server.

vibeCodex.extension.transport.markdownDescription: JSON-RPC transport used by external VS Code installs. `stdio` starts the configured Codex app-server process; `pipe` connects to an already-running Unix socket or Windows named pipe; `websocket` connects to an already-running WebSocket app-server.

vibeCodex.extension.pipePath.markdownDescription: Unix socket or Windows named pipe path used when `vibeCodex.extension.transport` is `pipe`.

vibeCodex.extension.websocketUrl.markdownDescription: ws:// or wss:// URL used when `vibeCodex.extension.transport` is `websocket`.

vibeCodex.extension.messageFraming.markdownDescription: JSON-RPC message framing for external backend transports. `ndjson` sends newline-delimited JSON; `content-length` sends LSP-style `Content-Length` headers.

vibeCodex.extension.provider.markdownDescription: Model provider used by the installable Vibe Codex extension. VS Code settings override sanitized Codex CLI config defaults; API key values stay in SecretStorage, Codex auth, or the user environment.

vibeCodex.extension.model.markdownDescription: Model name sent to the Vibecodex/Codex backend for external extension sessions. Leave blank to use the Codex CLI config/default provider model when available.

vibeCodex.extension.modeModels.markdownDescription: Optional per-mode model overrides keyed by `plan`, `ask`, `manual`, `act`, `agent`, `debug`, `review`, or `custom`. This lets Plan/Ask/Review use a reasoning model while Act/Agent/Debug use a faster local or OpenAI-compatible model without duplicating provider credentials.

vibeCodex.extension.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL for local or third-party providers. Leave blank to use the matching base URL from `~/.codex/config.toml` or the provider default.

vibeCodex.extension.parallelThreads.markdownDescription: Number of isolated Vibe Codex agent lanes to request for app-server execution. Values above 1 request git-worktree isolation and judge-before-merge review.

vibeCodex.extension.commandPermissions.d.markdownDescription: Allow terminal commands by default after exact visual plan approval unless a deny rule or built-in dangerous-command rule matches. Set false to require an allow rule for every terminal command.

vibeCodex.extension.commandPermissions.a.markdownDescription: Command permission allow patterns for backend terminal execution. Patterns are case-insensitive, support `*`, and also match command prefixes such as `npm test`.

vibeCodex.extension.commandPermissions.d.markdownDescription: Command permission deny patterns for backend terminal execution. Deny rules and built-in dangerous-command blocking always win over allow rules and auto-approval.

vibeCodex.extension.autoApprove.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable opt-in auto-approval for selected Vibe Codex backend requests after an exact visual plan revision has been approved.

vibeCodex.extension.autoApprove.terminal.markdownDescription: Auto-approve non-blocked terminal approval requests when auto-approval is enabled and a plan execution authorization exists.

vibeCodex.extension.autoApprove.file.markdownDescription: Auto-approve non-blocked file change approval requests when auto-approval is enabled, max risk allows it, and a plan execution authorization exists.

vibeCodex.extension.autoApprove.tool.markdownDescription: Auto-approve non-blocked generic tool approval requests when auto-approval is enabled and a plan execution authorization exists.

vibeCodex.extension.autoApprove.generic.markdownDescription: Auto-approve non-blocked generic approval requests when auto-approval is enabled and a plan execution authorization exists.

vibeCodex.extension.autoApprove.mcp.markdownDescription: Auto-approve non-blocked MCP tool/resource requests when auto-approval is enabled, max risk allows it, and a plan execution authorization exists.

vibeCodex.extension.autoApprove.browser.markdownDescription: Auto-approve supported browser open/navigate requests when auto-approval is enabled and a plan execution authorization exists.

vibeCodex.extension.autoApprove.maxRisk.markdownDescription: Highest request risk level eligible for Vibe Codex auto-approval. Blocked requests are never auto-approved.

vibeCodex.extension.autoCommit.enabled.markdownDescription: Expose opt-in auto-commit readiness after Final Review passes. This setting never stages or commits by itself; a commit still requires explicit user action or an approved terminal request.

vibeCodex.extension.notifications.approv.markdownDescription: Show VS Code notifications when Vibe Codex is waiting for plan, tool, MCP, browser, or diff approval.

vibeCodex.extension.notifications.termin.markdownDescription: Show VS Code notifications when captured Vibe Codex terminal runs complete.

vibeCodex.extension.notifications.longRu.markdownDescription: Seconds before Vibe Codex notifies that a captured terminal command is still running. Set to 0 to disable long-running terminal notifications.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build-ext && npm run test:extension && npm run package-vsix
